items.h: Parkinson (concussion) logged a limited practice session Wednesday, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official sitereports.
items.s: Parkinson is in the league's concussion protocol after suffering a head injury in Thursday's loss to the 49ers. Though Parkinson will need to be officially cleared, coach Sean McVay said that he expects the tight end to be available in Week 6 against Jacksonville.
